scope.statement: The study says its Yudu uncle terms chiefly reflect the traditional prestige variety spoken in Gongjiang Town, citing Xie 1998. It assigns Yudu to Yu-Xin Hakka. Town reference, not an assertion of uniform speech throughout the county.
scope.method: Literature-based terms checked with consultants; p.80 says Yudu data fall within the varieties verified online during2018–2022. Table3-3,p.82 lists YDH-1, a male in his30s, as a key informant, not an exhaustive consultant count. The verification period is not an item recording date. No audio is supplied with this selection.
scope.notation: Section 3.3.3 p.83 explicitly calls the superscript numbers tone values, generally disregarding sandhi unless necessary. Retain single 5 as supplied, never expand to 55. Zero-containing forms held because the key does not explain zero.
scope.register: Referential kinship terms; source excludes terms of address and non-kin uses (p.83).
